business_objective: Create a clear, welcoming public information website explaining La Bulle Bleue and helping visitors contact APAiL to ask about attendance or volunteering.
primary_user_intent: Understand the initiative, who it welcomes and how to make first contact.
critical_journeys: Homepage → audience → activity examples → email contact
Homepage → association → volunteering interest → email contact
functional_requirements: Single-page information architecture with anchor navigation
Visible mailto contact links using publicly published email
No disputed address or stale weekly schedule
content_requirements: Describe reported audience and activity examples without overpromising
Explain first contact and volunteer interest
Direct visitors to confirm current venue, dates and hours

brand.direction: Warm, calm, reassuring, modern and inclusive across ages; not clinical or infantilizing
brand.provisional_system: Deep/soft blues, muted yellow, peach, sage and lilac; typographic wordmark and CSS illustration
brand.replacement: Use official identity if later provided

technical.architecture: Static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript

accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA; candidate evidence covers structural checks, keyboard navigation and selected contrast pairs only. Manual screen-reader assessment remains outstanding.
performance: No external runtime requests. Hosted performance metrics and budgets remain unmeasured.
success_criteria: Mobile menu works by pointer and keyboard
No horizontal overflow at tested widths
No unverified address, schedule, health claim or sensitive-data collection
loop_001_definition_of_done: Responsive static candidate, evidence records and tests committed to main; candidate checks pass; remote checkpoint verified; certification and deployment remain deferred.
